question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**huge**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that should be filled in the second blank is "**huge**."
 
• The sentence discusses how **some businesses responded during the pandemic.**
 
• Considering the context where businesses adapted and diversified, the word "**huge**" appropriately reflects that these businesses were able to generate significant or substantial profits. It indicates that their earnings were substantial in size, possibly much larger than expected or typical under the circumstances.
 
• The term "**huge**" emphasizes the scale or magnitude of the profits made during this challenging period. 

 

**Correct Usage:__** *Amidst all the chaos and suffering caused by the pandemic, there are some positive stories of grit, persistence, and bravado. Some businesses understood the needs of the times to make **huge** profits. Businesses diversified and (3)________successful. Although there are numerous stories of people and business owners (4)__________ due to lockdowns, this small percentage of success stories is like the light at the end of the (5)___________*
